claims.source_quote_ar: وَالْمَعْنَى يَتِمُّ بِدُخُولِ الْهَمْزَةِ عَلَى جُمْلَةِ الشَّرْطِ وَالْجَوَابِ
claims.claim_ar: المعنى يتمّ بدخول الهمزة على جملة الشرط والجواب (أي لا بدّ من دخول الهمزة في جملة الجواب/الشرط لإتمام المعنى).
claims.claim_en: The meaning is completed by the hamzah entering upon the conditional clause and its answer (i.e., the hamzah must enter on the clause of the answer/condition to complete the sense).

claims.source_quote_ar: وَالْفَاءُ تَدُلُّ عَلَى تَعَلُّقِ الشَّرْطِ بِمَا قَبْلَهُ
claims.claim_ar: حرف الفاء في (فَلَعَرَفْتَهُمْ) دليل على تعلق جواب الشرط بما قبله (أي الفاء تربط جواب الشرط بما يسبقه).
claims.claim_en: The prefixed fa' in (falarafta-hum) indicates that the answer of the conditional is attached to what precedes it (the fa' links the answer of the condition to the preceding clause).

claims.source_quote_ar: تَقْدِيرُهُ: أَتَنْقَلِبُونَ عَلَى أَعْقَابِكُمْ إِنْ مََاتَ
claims.claim_ar: يجوز تقدير جواب الشرط بإدخال همزة استفتاحية (بصيغة استفهامية) كما في المثال المذكور؛ أي أن صيغة الجواب قد تُقدَّر بدايةً بـألف الهمزة.
claims.claim_en: It is permissible to posit an implied reading of the answer that begins with an initial hamzah (interrogative/introductory 'a-'), as illustrated by the cited example; in other words, the answer clause can be understood with an implied initial hamzah.
claims.needs_review_reason: The cited taqdir example in the source refers to a different verse (example with "إن مات"); applying this specific taqdir to S47:30 is an inference rather than an explicit statement about this exact ayah.

warnings: The quoted passages in the source discuss the grammar of conditional constructions and give examples from other verses; the extracted claims apply those general points to S47:30 by inference.
One cited taqdir example in the source explicitly concerns a different verse (the example with "إِنْ مَاتَ"), so its application to this ayah should be reviewed.
